carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition between high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and shadowed pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated, high-luminance pixel cluster is visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
